nodes.name: Scraper Webhook
nodes.notes:
Receives POST from Python scraper.
Payload: JSON array of lead objects.
Configure scraper env: WEBHOOK_URL=https://[your-n8n-domain]/webhook/scraper-leads

parameters.query:
-- Check if this is a returning lead and whether it's day or night.
-- Uses LEFT JOIN to ensure is_daytime() always executes even if no returning lead.
WITH time_ctx AS (
  SELECT is_daytime() AS is_day, current_shift() AS current_shift
),
ret_lead AS (
  SELECT * FROM find_returning_lead($1, $2, $3) LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  r.conversation_id AS existing_conv_id,
  r.assigned_agent_id,
  r.current_property AS existing_property,
  r.same_property,
  r.mode AS existing_mode,
  t.is_day,
  t.current_shift
FROM time_ctx t
LEFT JOIN ret_lead r ON TRUE;

-- Returning lead, same property: update last_message_at on existing conversation.
UPDATE conversations
SET last_message_at = NOW()
WHERE conversation_id = $1::uuid
RETURNING conversation_id, assigned_agent_id, lead_name;

-- Get the assigned agent's WhatsApp number.
SELECT whatsapp_number FROM agents WHERE agent_id = $1;

-- Create new conversation for scraper lead (day mode).
-- ON CONFLICT: conversations_i24_lead_id_uniq blocks twin rows for the same
-- i24 inquiry (returning webhook retries / cross-run repeats). No row returned
-- for a duplicate, so no second auction is launched.
INSERT INTO conversations (lead_phone, lead_name, lead_email, current_property, mode, source, arrived_during, i24_lead_id, property_public_id)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'pending_assignment', $5, 'day', $6, NULLIF($7, ''))
ON CONFLICT (i24_lead_id) WHERE i24_lead_id IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
RETURNING conversation_id, property_public_id, lead_phone, lead_name, lead_email, current_property, mode, i24_lead_id;

INSERT INTO properties_cache (property_id, payload)
VALUES ($1, $2::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (property_id) DO UPDATE
  SET payload = EXCLUDED.payload, fetched_at = NOW();

-- Create new conversation for scraper lead (night mode).
INSERT INTO conversations (lead_phone, lead_name, lead_email, current_property, mode, source, arrived_during, i24_lead_id, property_public_id)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'night_queued', $5, 'night', $6, NULLIF($7, ''))
ON CONFLICT (i24_lead_id) WHERE i24_lead_id IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
RETURNING conversation_id, property_public_id, lead_phone, lead_name, lead_email, current_property, i24_lead_id;
